required_fixes: Redesign or remove B_UNFIXED_PROTOCOL_ONLY (C4) from SURVIVES gate until discriminating: frozen pair https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/ vs https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/about produces common prefix https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/ which passes Fix2 (_validate_prefix_boundary True, ends with '/') and also passes Fix3 (_is_protocol_only_prefix False because '/' in rest), so distill_parameterized returns Mechanism with slot_count=1 for both fixed and unfixed paths. Provide a pair where Fix2 passes but Fix3 should reject, or demonstrate Fix3 delta on synthetic PROTOCOL_ONLY vs minimal-path corpus and decouple Fix2 subsumption; alternatively downgrade C4 to exploratory until Fix3 is proved non-redundant

Fix _is_protocol_only_prefix over-broad rejection: current logic `if '/' not in rest: return True` rejects valid parameterizable query-only URLs with no path slash (e.g., https://api.example.com?key=abc vs https://api.example.com?key=xyz, prefix https://api.example.com?key= has rest 'api.example.com?key=' with no '/' so Fix3 returns True and distill returns None, blocking valid ?key= parameterization). Restrict Fix3 to scheme+authority only (e.g., require no '?'/'=' in rest before rejecting) and add regression tests for query-param parameterization

Fix C5 kernel_tests_run reporting inconsistency: run_existing_kernel_tests parses result.stdout for 'Ran N tests' but unittest -v writes to stderr, so producer metric condition_5_kernel_tests_run=0 in experiment_results.json vs 3 in result.json and actual 3/3 PASS; parse stderr or combined output and persist consistent artifact hashes so provenance does not show tests_run 0 with passed True

Fix C6 token methodology apples-to-oranges encoding: parameterized_total_tokens encodes json.dumps(template, sort_keys=True) including '{"method":"GET","url":...}' wrapper (3 templates -> 68 tokens) while literal_total_tokens encodes raw URLs (9 URLs -> 96 tokens) without wrapper and with 3x repetition by construction. Report comparable encodings (both JSON dumped or both raw), report per-template mean and per-resolution cost, and note that 29.17% saving is structural (3 vs 9 encodings) with absolute counts 68 vs 96 small; do not present as amortized economics

Persist corrected comment validation and valid-ID fixture documentation: keep validate_comment_body list-of-dicts fix and document unseen IDs posts 96-98 (1-100), users 8-10 (1-10), comments postId 5-7 as derived artifact with probe logs so future auditors can distinguish binding error from 404
